mapper.select: select mn.*, od.Od_Name as odName, od.Od_Type as odType, od.Od_Source as odSource, od.Od_Status as odStatus, od.Od_Remark as odRemark, od.Od_Address as odAddress, od.Od_Method as odMethod, od.Od_Body as odBody, od.od_alias as odAlias from Outline_Projec_Datasource mn left join Outline_Datasource od on od.id=mn.od_id where mn.id = #{id} order by mn.Create_Time desc

select mn.*, od.Od_Name as odName, od.Od_Type as odType, od.Od_Source as odSource, od.Od_Status as odStatus, od.Od_Remark as odRemark, od.Od_Address as odAddress, od.Od_Method as odMethod, od.Od_Body as odBody, od.od_alias as odAlias from Outline_Projec_Datasource mn left join Outline_Datasource od on od.id=mn.od_id where mn.opl_id = #{oplId} and mn.od_id = #{odId}
